execution_trigger: 2026-09-04 result-blind workflow trigger; no axis, estimand, ranking rule, or counterfactual pool changed
analysis_role: Post-result bounded specificity sensitivity using only the four climate axes frozen in the original orientation ecology screen. It asks whether BIO15 is merely one member of a broad climate gradient or remains the strongest current orientation correspondence across pre-existing axes. It cannot identify climatic selection or historical cause.

panels.full9: Brownian PGLS standardized D-minus-U effect across the same six accepted AU topologies
panels.japan_only7: same PGLS after removing the two Taiwan-source taxa
panels.lat_lon_adjusted9: Brownian GLS environment ~ orientation + z(mean latitude) + z(mean longitude)
panels.state_count_counterfactual: all choose(9,4)=126 U=5/D=4 maps; for each axis compare the observed signed magnitude in its observed direction with all maps
panels.recurrence_counterfactual: same exact six-topology recurrence-profile gate used by the frozen BIO15 counterfactual analysis

specificity_metrics.effect_rank: rank the four axes by absolute median standardized orientation coefficient separately for full9, Japan-only and lat/lon-adjusted panels
specificity_metrics.topology_stability: record sign agreement across all six accepted topologies
specificity_metrics.loo_stability: record species leave-one-out sign agreement where evaluable
specificity_metrics.counterfactual_extremeness: finite conditional fraction of maps at least as extreme in the observed signed direction; not a P value
specificity_metrics.focal_specificity_rule: BIO15 is called the strongest tested current axis only if it ranks first in absolute median coefficient in full9, Japan-only7 and lat_lon_adjusted9. No significance claim follows from this ranking.

claim_ceiling: The four axes are correlated and are not independent mechanistic candidates.
This analysis is post-result and cannot be treated as independent confirmation of BIO15.
Ranking among four frozen axes cannot establish precipitation seasonality as the causal driver.
No new environmental variable, transformed proxy, or month-specific variable may be added after result inspection.
Counterfactual fractions are finite conditional ranks, not P values or posterior probabilities.
